author: Stahly
description:
The wargaming and miniature painting industry has been completely wild over the last two months: we've unboxed new Space Marines, Tomb Kings, and Custodes, plus welcomed the brand-new Age of Sigmar faction, the Khazalite Holds. Stahly has put the new Warhammer Tone Pro paints through their paces, along with Ionic Real Heavy Metal and GSW's airbrush range, plus we've had painting and photography tutorials, and painted a load of minis too. You definitely don't want to miss this!

The post The best of Tale of Painters: September & October 2026 appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: The best of Tale of Painters: September & October 2026
